fieldValues.comment_text: Evidence from the srs-web lenses assessment (2026-10-09, srs-programme:source-documents/srs-web-lenses-2026-10-09/assessment.md#model). The owner described the working pattern this problem asks for: "draw a boundary, create distinctions, then see relationships. A boundary defines the set I want to see. A distinction defines what I want to tell apart: sometimes all fields are just fields, sometimes types of fields; sometimes types of containers, sometimes just nesting." A working proof of concept drew the same records into different sets (a container outline, a composition's sections, every record of a type) without moving them, and kept the selected record across sets. Not yet built: an ad hoc selection saved as a set, and the "tell apart by" control. Suggested remedy: open every repository through lenses (Suggestions, Remedy scout).
